integrity: All claims are from an analytical proof with supplementary exact symbolic checks; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Bounds are explicit and non-optimal; only b=5/2 and odd denominators q>=3. A finite checker supplements but does not certify the infinite proof. Earlier unindexed sufficient frame regions are an originality risk.
title: Uniform quantitative frames on the odd-denominator two-channel tent-spline lattice
